Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.
segments.note: Directive instituting a recurring practice, justified by an accompanying assertion in the same quoted turn; kept as one segment since both sentences serve the single move of establishing the cadence.
